marcadores.explicacao_original: The bronchiole is surrounded by alveoli, indicating that it is an intrapulmonary structure. However, none of the alveoli communicate with the lumen of the bronchiole, indicating that these alveoli are not a component of the bronchiolar wall and that the bronchiole, therefore, cannot participate in gas exchange. A bronchiole is a component part of the conducting portion of the respiratory system.
